entries.headline: Taiwan CDC adds Novavax as public COVID-19 option, urges shots before holiday
entries.zh: 連假將至 籲請符合流感及新冠疫苗公費接種資格民眾儘早接種 增加保護力 還可獲得健康幣
entries.why: Public programme (公費): eligible people aged 12+ can now choose Novavax alongside Moderna, and CDC has said it plans additional flu and Novavax doses. This changes brand choice within the tender arena, not the self-pay market.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署新增Novavax為公費COVID-19疫苗選項，呼籲連假前接種
entries.why_zh: 公費計畫：符合資格的12歲以上民眾現可選擇Novavax或Moderna，疾管署並表示計畫追加流感疫苗及Novavax疫苗。此舉改變的是採購標案領域內的廠牌選擇，而非自費市場。

entries.headline: CDC calls claimed Pentagon ban on Moderna mRNA flu vaccine false
entries.zh: 疾管署澄清網傳「十月十四日突發消息：五角大廈已在全美軍範圍內禁止採購和接種莫德納Moderna的mRNA流感疫苗」，為錯誤訊息並非事實，請民眾勿信勿轉傳
entries.why: CDC said the US military has not covered the vaccine only because US CDC has not yet recommended it; dozens of outlets carried the rebuttal and some coverage drew in Moderna's COVID-19 vaccine. Not tied to either funding arena, but it is a live reputational test for mRNA products during the public campaign.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署澄清美國國防部禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗說法為假訊息
entries.why_zh: 疾管署表示，美軍未納入該疫苗僅因美國CDC尚未建議使用；數十家媒體轉載澄清，部分報導並牽連Moderna的COVID-19疫苗。此事與公費或自費領域皆無直接關聯，但在公費接種期間對mRNA產品構成實際的聲譽考驗。

entries.headline: Public flu shots near 3.8 million in under a month; stock reportedly under half
entries.why: Mainly the public programme: CNA and others report close to 3.8 million doses, and ETtoday says remaining flu stock is below half while also covering self-pay options. Supply pacing before the 2 November second stage is the key question.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗不到一個月接種近380萬劑；據報庫存不到一半
entries.why_zh: 主要涉及公費計畫：中央社等媒體報導接種已近380萬劑，ETtoday指流感疫苗剩餘庫存不到一半，並介紹自費選項。11月2日第二階段開打前的供貨調度是關鍵問題。

entries.headline: Public flu antiviral eligibility extended to 15 November as weekly deaths hit 44
entries.zh: 因應流感疫情仍處流行期，公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥條件將延長至2026年11月15日止
entries.why: Public programme: CDC extended expanded antiviral criteria amid 159 severe cases and 44 deaths in a week, with media reporting H1N1 at 92.7%. Sustained severity keeps vaccination urgency high in official and media messaging.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大適用延長至11月15日，單週死亡達44例
entries.why_zh: 公費計畫：一週內新增159例重症、44例死亡，疾管署延長抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥條件，媒體報導H1N1占92.7%。疫情嚴重度持續，使官方與媒體訊息維持高度接種急迫性。

entries.headline: Doctors link flu to heart attack risk in older adults, discuss enhanced vaccines
entries.why: Physician-led coverage discusses adjuvanted and high-dose vaccines for older adults; one explainer also covers self-paid choices, so this touches both the public programme and the self-pay market. Funding is otherwise unstated.
entries.headline_zh: 醫師指流感與長者心肌梗塞風險相關，討論加強型疫苗
entries.why_zh: 醫師主導的報導討論長者適用的佐劑型與高劑量疫苗；其中一篇衛教文也介紹自費選項，因此同時觸及公費計畫與自費市場。其餘未說明經費來源。

entries.headline: Threads posts push COVID-19 vaccine-injury claims; pregnant user delays RSV after Tdap
entries.why: Users claim long COVID is vaccine injury and cite clots and relatives' deaths, while a pregnant poster reports an ER visit after Tdap and says the couple will delay RSV, though her doctor said the symptoms were unrelated. These are thin, unverified signals and the funding arena is not stated.
entries.headline_zh: Threads貼文散播COVID-19疫苗傷害說法；孕婦接種Tdap後延後接種RSV疫苗
entries.why_zh: 有使用者聲稱長COVID-19其實是疫苗傷害，並提及血栓與親友死亡；另一名懷孕網友表示接種Tdap後掛急診，夫妻倆將延後接種RSV疫苗，但醫師表示症狀與疫苗無關。這些訊號零星且未經查證，亦未說明經費領域。

watch.text: Second-stage public eligibility opens. Kaohsiung expands to adults 50+, and Nantou starts offering 400 donated doses to non-subsidised groups.
watch.text_zh: 第二階段公費對象開放接種。高雄擴大至50歲以上成人，南投開始提供400劑捐贈疫苗予非公費對象。

watch.text: Expanded public flu antiviral criteria expire; watch whether CDC extends them a third time if severity stays high.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥條件到期；若疫情嚴重度仍高，留意疾管署是否第三度延長。

watch.text: Flu vaccine stock reported below half; watch for CDC top-up deliveries of flu and Novavax doses and any local shortages.
watch.text_zh: 據報流感疫苗庫存不到一半；留意疾管署追加流感及Novavax疫苗的到貨情形，以及各地是否缺貨。

qa.q: Does the Moderna 'Pentagon ban' rumour affect Taiwan's programme?
qa.a: CDC called it false: the US military has not covered the mRNA flu vaccine only because US CDC has not yet recommended it. Coverage was heavy on 20-21 October, and some articles also mentioned Moderna's COVID-19 vaccine, so mRNA-related questions may linger.
qa.q_zh: Moderna遭「美國國防部禁用」謠言是否影響台灣接種計畫？
qa.a_zh: 疾管署澄清為假訊息：美軍未納入mRNA流感疫苗，僅因美國CDC尚未建議使用。相關報導集中於10月20至21日，部分文章亦提及Moderna的COVID-19疫苗，mRNA相關疑問可能持續存在。

qa.q: Is there public-programme supply pressure on flu vaccine?
qa.a: Media report close to 3.8 million public doses in under a month, and ETtoday says stock is below half. CDC said on 13 October it plans additional flu and Novavax doses, and second-stage groups open on 2 November.
qa.q_zh: 公費流感疫苗是否面臨供貨壓力？
qa.a_zh: 媒體報導公費疫苗不到一個月已接種近380萬劑，ETtoday指庫存不到一半。疾管署10月13日表示計畫追加流感及Novavax疫苗，第二階段對象將於11月2日開打。

qa.q: What is being said about enhanced flu vaccines this week?
qa.a: Doctors' pieces link flu to cardiovascular risk in older adults and discuss adjuvanted and high-dose options. Malan Veterans Home began public vaccination that includes enhanced flu vaccines. Enhanced-type mentions fell to 10 from 43 week on week, while high-dose mentions held at 13.
qa.q_zh: 本週關於加強型流感疫苗的討論有哪些？
qa.a_zh: 醫師文章將流感與長者心血管風險連結，並討論佐劑型與高劑量選項。馬蘭榮譽國民之家已開始公費接種，包括加強型流感疫苗。加強型相關提及量較前週由43則降至10則，高劑量提及量則持平於13則。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: This notice set the 2026-27 narrative that public flu and COVID-19 uptake is outpacing last year and urged high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告定調2026-27年度敘事：公費流感與COVID-19疫苗接種進度超越去年，並呼籲高風險族群於連假出遊前接種。

policy_notes.why: Confirms strong public uptake, adds Novavax to the public COVID-19 programme from 19 October and signals extra flu and Novavax procurement, a direct tender-arena development.
policy_notes.why_zh: 證實公費接種踴躍，自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19接種計畫，並釋出追加採購流感及Novavax疫苗訊號，屬採購標案領域的直接進展。

policy_notes.why: The pre-holiday appeal reiterates Novavax as a public option and ties vaccination to health-coin incentives to sustain momentum.
policy_notes.why_zh: 連假前呼籲重申Novavax為公費選項，並以健康幣獎勵連結接種以維持動能。

policy_notes.why: Extending expanded antiviral eligibility to 15 November signals CDC judges the flu season still in its epidemic phase.
policy_notes.why_zh: 將抗病毒藥劑擴大適用延長至11月15日，顯示疾管署判斷流感仍處流行期。

policy_notes.why: The physician circular operationalises the antiviral extension for high-transmission groups and asks doctors to make full use of the public supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 致醫師函落實高傳播族群的抗病毒藥劑延長措施，並請醫師善用公費藥劑。

policy_notes.why: An official rebuttal of a viral mRNA vaccine rumour shows CDC is actively policing vaccine misinformation during the campaign.
policy_notes.why_zh: 官方澄清廣傳的mRNA疫苗謠言，顯示疾管署在接種期間積極處理疫苗假訊息。

misinfo.claim: The Pentagon has banned procurement and use of Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine across the US military
misinfo.note: CDC has already issued a rebuttal that outlets amplified widely; track for resurfacing and defer to the official clarification.
misinfo.claim_zh: 美國國防部已禁止全美軍採購及使用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗
misinfo.note_zh: 疾管署已發布澄清並獲媒體廣泛轉載；持續追蹤是否再度流傳，並以官方澄清為準。

misinfo.claim: Long COVID does not exist and is actually COVID-19 vaccine injury
misinfo.note: This is the highest-engagement post of the week; prepare evidence summaries for health-professional partners in case it spreads beyond Threads.
misinfo.claim_zh: 長COVID-19並不存在，其實是COVID-19疫苗傷害
misinfo.note_zh: 此為本週互動數最高的貼文；應為醫療專業合作夥伴準備實證摘要，以防擴散至Threads以外。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines carry a black box warning and caused relatives' deaths or serious illness
misinfo.note: Anecdotal posts with low engagement; monitor without amplifying and keep regulator-sourced labelling facts ready.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗有黑框警語，並導致親友死亡或重病
misinfo.note_zh: 屬個人經驗貼文且互動低；監測但勿擴大聲量，並備妥主管機關仿單資訊。

misinfo.claim: Blood clots did not exist before COVID-19 vaccines
misinfo.note: Low reach; no proactive response needed, but log it alongside personal clot stories for trend tracking.
misinfo.note_zh: 觸及率低；無須主動回應，但應與個人血栓經驗一併記錄以追蹤趨勢。

misinfo.claim: Vaccine deaths and side effects have never been studied
misinfo.note: Appears inside an otherwise pro-vaccine post; low reach, so simply track it.
misinfo.claim_zh: 疫苗死亡與副作用從未被研究過
misinfo.note_zh: 出現在一則整體支持疫苗的貼文中；觸及率低，僅需追蹤。

narratives.para: A viral claim that the Pentagon banned Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine was called false by Taiwan CDC, which said the vaccine is simply not yet recommended or covered, and dozens of outlets carried the correction.

narratives.para_zh: 網傳美國國防部禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗，疾管署澄清為假訊息，表示該疫苗僅是尚未獲建議或納入給付，數十家媒體轉載更正。

narratives.title: Public flu uptake nears 3.8 million doses; Kaohsiung reports double-digit gains
narratives.para: Coverage tracks public flu doses approaching 3.8 million in under a month, a 9.5% year-on-year rise, and Kaohsiung flu and COVID-19 uptake up 13.6% and 36.1%.

narratives.para_zh: 報導追蹤公費流感疫苗不到一個月接種近380萬劑，年增9.5%；高雄流感及COVID-19疫苗接種量分別增加13.6%與36.1%。

narratives.title: Novavax public COVID-19 vaccine available from October 19 for ages 12+
narratives.para: Taiwan CDC added Novavax as a publicly funded COVID-19 option from October 19, letting eligible people aged 12 and over choose a brand, and plans additional Novavax doses.

narratives.title: Flu severity stays high: 44 weekly deaths, H1N1 above 90%, Nantou deaths
narratives.para: Weekly data show 159 new severe flu cases, 44 deaths and 123,000 medical visits, H1N1 dominant, and Nantou reporting flu and COVID-19 death rates above national levels.

narratives.para_zh: 每週數據顯示新增159例流感重症、44例死亡、門急診12.3萬人次，以H1N1為主；南投流感及COVID-19死亡率高於全國。

narratives.title: Publicly funded flu antiviral eligibility extended to November 15
narratives.para: Taiwan CDC extended expanded eligibility for publicly funded flu antivirals for high-transmission groups to November 15 and urged physicians to use them.

flu season severity and public antiviral extension
narratives.title_zh: 公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大適用延長至11月15日
narratives.para_zh: 疾管署將高傳播族群公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大適用延長至11月15日，並呼籲醫師善加使用。

narratives.title: Unvaccinated traveller's NT$600,000 hospital bill becomes a cautionary story
narratives.para: Several outlets report an elderly woman who skipped flu vaccination, caught influenza in Thailand and ran up about NT$600,000 in hospital costs.

narratives.para_zh: 多家媒體報導一名未接種流感疫苗的長者赴泰國感染流感，住院費用約NT$600,000。

narratives.title: Local governments push holiday services, school drives and institutional rollouts
narratives.para: Keelung, Nantou, Pingtung and a veterans home publicise holiday clinic hours, school drives, incentives and the start of public flu, enhanced flu and COVID-19 vaccination.

narratives.para_zh: 基隆、南投、屏東及一所榮家宣傳連假門診時間、校園接種、獎勵措施，以及公費流感、加強型流感與COVID-19疫苗開打。

narratives.para: Physician-led pieces frame flu as a heart-attack risk for older adults and discuss adjuvanted and high-dose vaccines, while general enhanced-vaccine launch coverage has cooled.

narratives.para_zh: 醫師主導的文章將流感定位為長者心肌梗塞風險，並討論佐劑型與高劑量疫苗；加強型疫苗上市的一般報導則已降溫。

narratives.para: Reports say flu vaccine stock is under half, Nantou will give 400 donated doses to non-subsidised groups from November 2, and an anonymous post alleging a vaccine procurement price drew a Medigen response.

narratives.para_zh: 報導指流感疫苗庫存不到一半，南投將自11月2日起提供400劑捐贈疫苗予非公費對象；一則匿名貼文指稱疫苗採購價格，引發高端疫苗回應。

narratives.para: RSV volume halved, limited to doctor pieces on risks for older and chronically ill adults and pregnancy posts describing side effects and delaying RSV vaccination.

narratives.title_zh: RSV討論減少：長者風險文章與孕婦猶豫貼文

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Nothing this week on Beyfortus or infant RSV antibodies; RSV coverage centred on older and chronically ill adults, plus a pregnancy post saying a couple will delay RSV vaccination after side effects from other shots.
products.implication: The infant-protection conversation is quiet, and the only maternal signal is hesitancy-tinged, so any parent-facing debate could start from side-effect anecdotes rather than policy.
products.action: Keep monitoring maternal and infant RSV threads; prepare a neutral evidence pack on infant RSV burden and prevention pathways for paediatric and obstetric societies, ready for any policy or funding discussion.
products.signal_zh: 本週無Beyfortus或嬰兒RSV抗體相關討論；RSV報導集中於長者與慢性病成人，另有一則孕期貼文表示夫妻倆因其他疫苗副作用將延後接種RSV疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒保護相關討論平靜，唯一的孕產婦訊號帶有猶豫色彩，因此任何面向家長的爭論可能源自副作用個案而非政策。
products.action_zh: 持續監測孕產婦與嬰兒RSV討論串；為兒科及婦產科醫學會準備中立的嬰兒RSV疾病負擔與預防途徑實證資料，以備任何政策或經費討論。

新生兒及兒科醫院主管

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda, publicly funded for 65+ in long-term care and residential facilities
products.signal: Doctor-led media pieces discuss flu-linked heart attack risk in older adults and mention adjuvanted and high-dose vaccines; one piece presents high-dose vaccines as a new option for seniors. Enhanced vaccines are being given at a veterans home, and reports say overall flu vaccine stock is under half.
products.implication: Enhanced flu talk is moving from launch news to clinician framing, which builds the case for future eligibility discussions but invites scrutiny of industry links. Falling stock ahead of the November 2 expansion may prompt questions about enhanced-dose allocation.
products.action: Check that any company-supported media or physician content complies with Taiwan's prescription-medicine advertising rules; prepare factual Q&A on enhanced-dose deployment in long-term care with the CDC and facility operators; assemble real-world data for geriatric and cardiology societies.
who: Taiwan Association of Gerontology and Geriatrics
products.sub_zh: Efluelda，公費提供長照及住宿式機構65歲以上住民
products.signal_zh: 醫師主導的媒體文章討論流感相關的長者心肌梗塞風險，並提及佐劑型與高劑量疫苗；一篇文章將高劑量疫苗介紹為長者的新選項。榮家正在接種加強型疫苗，報導指流感疫苗整體庫存不到一半。
products.implication_zh: 加強型流感疫苗的討論正從上市新聞轉向臨床醫師觀點，有助於未來擴大對象的討論，但也可能引來對業界關係的檢視。11月2日擴大接種前庫存下降，可能引發加強型疫苗分配的疑問。
products.action_zh: 確認任何由公司支持的媒體或醫師內容符合台灣處方藥廣告規範；與疾管署及機構業者準備長照加強型疫苗配送的事實問答；為老年醫學及心臟學會彙整真實世界數據。
who_zh: 台灣老年學暨老年醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Very thin: Tdap mentions fell from 7 to 3. Two Threads posts describe side effects, one from a pregnant user who went to the ER after the shot (her doctor said the symptoms were unrelated) and one reporting evening fever and headache.
products.implication: No policy or media movement; maternal side-effect anecdotes are low-reach but could feed broader pregnancy hesitancy alongside RSV and flu.
products.action: Keep obstetric clinicians supplied with official TFDA and CDC safety information and a clear adverse-event reporting pathway; monitor whether pregnancy side-effect posts gain traction.
products.sub_zh: 百日咳追加劑，含孕期接種
products.signal_zh: 聲量極低：Tdap提及數由7則降至3則。兩則Threads貼文描述副作用，一則來自接種後掛急診的孕婦（醫師表示症狀無關），另一則提及晚間發燒與頭痛。
products.implication_zh: 無政策或媒體動態；孕婦副作用個案觸及率低，但可能與RSV及流感一同助長更廣泛的孕期疫苗猶豫。
products.action_zh: 持續提供婦產科醫師食藥署與疾管署官方安全資訊及明確的不良事件通報管道；監測孕期副作用貼文是否擴散。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed by Sanofi, public programme from Oct 19
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added Novavax as a publicly funded option from October 19 and plans additional Novavax doses; news reports say eligible people aged 12 and over can choose it, and CDC's holiday appeal repeats the option.
products.implication: Awareness depends on CDC and local health bureau messaging in the first weeks, and clinic-level stock and eligibility clarity will shape early experience.
products.action: Work with the CDC and local health bureaus to ensure accurate eligibility and site information reaches contracted clinics; track distribution questions; keep brand-neutral safety Q&A ready given ongoing COVID-19 safety misinformation online.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單位疫苗，由Sanofi經銷，10月19日起納入公費
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起新增Novavax為公費選項，並計畫追加Novavax疫苗；新聞報導指符合資格的12歲以上民眾可選擇，疾管署連假呼籲亦重申此選項。
products.implication_zh: 民眾認知取決於前幾週疾管署與地方衛生局的宣導，診所端庫存與資格說明是否清楚將影響初期接種經驗。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署及地方衛生局合作，確保正確的資格與接種地點資訊傳達至合約院所；追蹤配送問題；鑑於網路上COVID-19安全假訊息持續，備妥不分廠牌的安全問答。
who_zh: 中華民國醫師公會全國聯合會

issues.title: Second-stage expansion to adults 50+ while flu vaccine stock is under half
issues.note: Kaohsiung confirms expansion to 50+ on November 2 and reports say stock is below half; expect questions on allocation, top-up deliveries and enhanced-dose availability.
issues.title_zh: 流感疫苗庫存不到一半之際，第二階段擴大至50歲以上成人
issues.note_zh: 高雄證實11月2日擴大至50歲以上，報導指庫存不到一半；預期將出現分配、追加到貨及加強型疫苗供應的疑問。

issues.title: Imported vaccine rumours spread to new brands or products
issues.note: The Pentagon-ban rumour shows US-origin claims spread quickly and need CDC rebuttal; keep factual holding lines ready for any portfolio product.
issues.title_zh: 境外疫苗謠言擴及其他廠牌或產品
issues.note_zh: 國防部禁用謠言顯示源自美國的說法擴散迅速，需疾管署澄清；應為所有產品備妥事實性回應口徑。

issues.title: Scrutiny of public vaccine procurement prices
issues.note: An anonymous post alleging a vaccine procurement price drew a Medigen response; tender pricing questions could widen to other suppliers.
issues.title_zh: 公費疫苗採購價格受檢視
issues.note_zh: 一則匿名貼文指稱疫苗採購價格，引發高端疫苗回應；標案價格疑問可能擴及其他供應商。

self_pay.title: Self-pay enhanced flu appears in explainers, without prices
self_pay.note: Consumer explainers and stock reports cover public and self-paid options, including adjuvanted and high-dose vaccines, but give no clinic prices or self-pay stock figures.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費加強型流感疫苗見於衛教文，但未列價格
self_pay.note_zh: 消費者衛教文與庫存報導涵蓋公費及自費選項，包括佐劑型與高劑量疫苗，但未提供診所價格或自費庫存數據。

self_pay.title: Non-subsidised demand partly met by donations
self_pay.note: Nantou will give 400 company-donated flu doses free to non-subsidised groups from November 2, suggesting local demand outside eligibility that is being met outside the private market.
self_pay.title_zh: 非公費需求部分由捐贈滿足
self_pay.note_zh: 南投將自11月2日起免費提供400劑企業捐贈流感疫苗予非公費對象，顯示資格外的在地需求正由私人市場以外的管道滿足。

self_pay.title: No self-pay signal for RSV infant antibodies or Tdap
self_pay.note: This week's RSV and Tdap items are personal side-effect posts with no information on clinic stock, prices or private demand.
self_pay.title_zh: RSV嬰兒抗體及Tdap無自費訊號
self_pay.note_zh: 本週RSV與Tdap相關內容皆為個人副作用貼文，無診所庫存、價格或私人需求資訊。
